def solve(case):
    nodes = {node['id']: node for node in case['nodes']}
    children = {node['id']: [] for node in case['nodes']}
    for node in case['nodes']:
        if node['parent'] is not None:
            children[node['parent']].append(node['id'])
    required = set(case['required_symbols'])
    retained = set(nodes.keys())
    # Order: depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_ids = sorted(nodes.keys(), key=lambda nid: ( -nodes[nid]['depth'], nid ))
    removed = []
    for nid in sorted_ids:
        node = nodes[nid]
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        # Check if any child is retained
        if any(child in retained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        # Check required symbols
        if node['symbol'] in required:
            # Check if there is another node with this symbol
            if not any(nodes[oid]['symbol'] == node['symbol'] for oid in retained if oid != nid):
                continue
        # Remove
        retained.remove(nid)
        removed.append(nid)
    return {
        'removed_node_ids': removed,
        'retained_node_ids': sorted(retained)  # sort strings
    }
